council: London Borough of Richmond upon Thames
current_date: Agreed for adoption 19 February 2026; in effect from 20 February 2026 (Version 1)
current_evidence: The council's 'Make a planning application' page links the checklist, saying it 'took effect on 20 February 2026'. Its version table shows only 'Version 1 19/2/2026 20/2/2026 Full update following public consultation', and Grokbot's /media/18491/ URL serves the same Version 1 text.

issues.detail: Grokbot captured about 40 requirement rows, but the checklist has 83 items. The missing local items are listed here with their triggers. 11 Statement of Community Involvement (major). 18 Streetscape Drawings (infill development). 19 Townscape and Visual Impact Assessment (major; tall buildings of 7+ storeys or 21m+; harm to designated views). 21 Inclusive Design Statement (all except householder). 25 Parking Survey (likely to reduce on-street capacity). 28 Outline Construction Logistics Plan (major). 29 Draft Delivery and Servicing Plan (major or high servicing). 30 Outline CEMP. 31 Outline Site Waste Management Plan. 35 Flood Emergency Plan. 38 Foul Sewage and Utilities Statement (major). 40 Affordable Housing Financial Contribution (1 to 9 units). 43 Specialist Housing Operational Management Plan. 45 Statement of Engagement with Education Providers. 46 Town Centre Uses Sequential Test / 47 Retail-Leisure Impact Assessment (over 500 sqm outside centres). 48 Sustainable Construction Checklist (1+ new dwellings; non-residential over 100 sqm). 50 GLA Carbon Emission Reporting Spreadsheet (major). 51 BREEAM Pre-Assessment. 52 Circular Economy Statement and 53 Whole Life-Cycle Carbon Assessment (GLA-referable, 10+ units or 500 sqm+ non-residential). 55 Play and Child Occupancy Assessment (major). 56 Playing Fields and Sport Facilities Assessment. 57 Framework Community Use Agreement. 58 Framework Local Employment Agreement. 59 Draft Affordable Workspace Management Plan. 61 Landscaping Scheme (major; minor with significant landscaping). 63/64 Draft Tree Protection Plan and Arboricultural Method Statement. 66 Ecological Enhancement Statement (BNG-exempt, not householders). 68 Green Roof/Walls Details. 69 Urban Greening Factor Assessment (major). 70 Open Land Assessment (Green Belt, MOL, Local Green Space, OOLTI). 74 to 76 Air Quality Assessment, Air Quality Neutral and Air Quality Positive (major / EIA major). 77 Daylight, Sunlight and Overshadowing (major or where light could be affected). 80 Takeaway Statement (new hot food takeaway within 400m of a school). 81 Evening Economy and Food and Drink Management Plan. 82 Outbuildings/Granny Annexe Statement. 83 Telecommunications Statement (all telecoms, including Part 16 prior approval).
issues.evidence: Local Validation Checklist for All Applications (Version 1, 20/2/2026), Part 2 local requirements items 9 to 83.
issues.grok_comment: Many items are indeed missing, but some of the listed ones are partly captured under other names. The Arboricultural row ("...and Tree Protection Plan where required") and the "Schedule of works" row ("draft Arboricultural Method Statement (AMS) must be submitted") cover items 63/64, and the HIA row carries the Takeaway Statement 400m buffer-zone text (item 80).
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. Items 63/64 and 80 are partly captured under other rows. The other missing items stand.

issues.detail: Advertisement consent is shown as '(none)', but item 22 'Advertisements Plans and Drawings' applies specifically to advertisement consent, and item 71 Lighting Assessment covers adverts with external lighting. Grokbot put 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details' under Full planning as INFERRED. Prior approval also lacks item 83 Telecommunications Statement, which explicitly covers Part 16 GPDO prior approvals.
issues.evidence: Item 22 'Advertisements Plans and Drawings - Advertisement consent'. Item 83 'All telecommunications development, including permitted development and prior-approval applications under Part 16 of the GPDO 2015'.

issues.detail: Nearly every row (37) is 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', and Householder has a single row ('Sunlight to gardens', taken from basement cross-section text). The checklist has a householder quick guide naming the local items that apply to single houses: plans, CIL, heritage, schedules of works, structural impact, archaeology, CMP for basements, parking layouts, fire safety strategy, the FRA declaration form, drainage, basements, AIA/TPP/AMS, ecology, green roofs, open land, lighting, noise, daylight, contaminated land and outbuildings. Major-only items such as Health Impact Assessment, Fire Statement and Planning Statement are not flagged as major-only.
issues.evidence: Householder quick guide in the checklist. Item 79 HIA: 'All major development'. Item 33 Fire Statement: 'Major'. Item 10 Planning Statement: 'Major (encouraged for other development)'.

issues.detail: Under Outline, Grokbot lists 'Landscaping scheme / Landscape plan' with the trigger 'A full landscaping scheme is not required for outline applications.' That sentence is an exemption, not a requirement. Under 'Change of use - prior approval', Grokbot lists 'Energy / Sustainability Statement', but item 49 applies to planning applications creating 1+ new dwellings (including by change of use) or non-residential space over 100 sqm, not to prior approvals.
issues.evidence: Row trigger 'A full landscaping scheme is not required for outline applications.' Item 49 Energy Statement threshold is the same as item 48: 'New residential (1+ units); non-residential new build or extensions over 100 sqm'.

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts belong to a different item or are cut off. 'Health Impact Assessment' has the 400m buffer-zone policies-map text (from the Takeaway Statement); the real trigger is all major development. 'Contaminated Land' has HIA/policy text. 'Existing and proposed site levels' has lighting text. 'Waste / Refuse' has use-class floorspace text. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' has 'draft Arboricultural Method Statement (AMS) must be submitted'. 'Noise' gives only the air source heat pump MCS 020 exemption. 'Planning Statement' has SCI text. 'Fire Statement' reads 'Fire Safety Strategy or Reasonable Exception Statement THRESHOLD WHAT IS REQUIRED to adverse environmental effects. 3.', which merges item 32 (FSS/RES, all development) with item 33 (Fire Statement, major only). 'Archaeological Assessment' reads only 'Archaeological Assessment WHAT IS REQUIRED 1.'.
issues.evidence: Item 79 HIA 'All major development'. Item 32 'Fire Safety Strategy or Reasonable Exception Statement - All development'. Item 33 'Fire Statement - Major'.

issues.detail: Several tab items are web-page text, contact details or advisory fragments rather than requirements. Examples: 'Applying by email ... DCTechnicalSupportHub@richmond.gov.uk'; the 'Personal information ... Freedom of Information Act 2000' disclosure notice; 'The Local Validation Checklist (pdf, 437 KB) which was subject to public consultation and took effect on 20 February 2026'; 'Failure to respond by the deadline will result in the application being returned'; 'Photomontages with clearly annotated dimensions are also helpful'; 'In some cases, an annotated Site Plan and accompanying paragraph can meet this requirement'. Some drawing-standard items include table header text ('10 POLICIES & GUIDANCE Official LOCAL REQUIREMENTS THRESHOLD WHAT IS REQUIRED').
issues.evidence: tab_items 'Submission rules' entries sourced from make_a_planning_application, and 'Drawing / document standards' entries.

issues.detail: The list date 2026-02-01 comes from PDF metadata. The document says it was agreed for adoption on 19 February 2026 and came into effect on 20 February 2026, a date Grokbot itself captured in a tab item.
issues.evidence: 'Agreed for adoption on 19 February 2026'. 'Version 1 19/2/2026 20/2/2026 Full update following public consultation.'

issues.detail: The council page now links the checklist at /media/nkwku4in/. Grokbot's /media/18491/ URL still serves the same Version 1 document but is no longer the one linked from the planning page, so it may stop working.

summary: Grokbot found the current Richmond list (Version 1, in effect from 20 February 2026), though its date comes from PDF metadata and the planning page now links a different URL. The extraction misses about half of the 83 local requirements (Air Quality, UGF, Daylight/Sunlight, Circular Economy, Whole Life Carbon, TVIA, Telecoms and others). It puts almost everything under Full planning, leaves Advertisement consent empty despite the advert-specific item, and has many triggers taken from other items.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
